types.name: Knowledge Base Entity
types.description: Anything in the Knowledge Base: the base type of its items, and the type of those of no other kind.

types.name: Person
types.description: A person, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Organisation
types.description: An organisation, such as a company, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Organisational Unit
types.description: A part of an organisation, such as a department, in the Knowledge Base (X.500's organizationalUnit).

types.name: Place
types.description: A place, such as a country, locality, or address, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Group
types.description: A group of people, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Conversation
types.description: A conversation: a channel, direct message, or group chat, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Message
types.description: An instant message, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: URL
types.description: A place on the web, in the Knowledge Base, with what's been fetched from it.

types.name: Book
types.description: A book, as a creation, in the Knowledge Base: its editions, formats and copies are under it.

types.name: Book Text
types.description: A book's text, such as a translation, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Book Edition
types.description: An edition or format of a book, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Book Copy
types.description: A copy of a book, on a shelf or as a file, in the Knowledge Base.

types.name: Tag
types.description: A tag, which anything can have: its page lists what has it.
